name: Feature Foundry V24 — Native Living World
body:
## Feature Foundry V24 — Native Living World

A complete TypeScript + Rust/Tauri living-world studio preserving the exact V24 contract and adding a GPU-accelerated Three.js world, verified V33 and artist-world catalogs, native SQLite, real media surfaces, object ecology, and provider-aware room soundtracks.

### Verified systems
- Exact V24 body, CSS, runtime, classes, wording, data attributes, and behavior contract
- 17 approved V33 themes, 34 rooms, 85 ecology objects
- 10 current artist worlds, 20 districts, 21 exact music routes
- Frutiger Aero and ornate Frawgy living-world presentations at 1536×1024
- Spotify PKCE desktop loopback, MusicKit v3, and real external adapters for all six providers
- Local/direct/YouTube Living Screen Studio with animated TV idle channel
- Native SQLite integrity and exact seed counts verified from the release executable

### Artifacts
- Complete release bundle containing every artifact below
- Windows x64 NSIS setup executable
- Windows x64 MSI installer
- Portable production web build
- Complete source bundle
- SHA-256 checksum manifest

The Windows binaries are release-optimized but not Authenticode-signed, so Windows may show a publisher/reputation prompt.
